judgment.notes: N001 is instantiated with g and its real mean-zero Fourier truncations, all in the same H^gamma ball; their L2 norms sum to at most 2R. N011 therefore applies to every smooth truncation with its common C0,tau0. N006 supplies the Sobolev isometries and H^1 product bound used term by term in D009-D010; Dinv on general L2 inputs is justified by removing the zero mode (BG002). The scalar mean term is justified by BG003. There are no E/M applications.

S001 establishes ball-preserving smooth approximation and uniform-in-time L2 convergence of the exact flows. In S002 every increment is a finite composition of bounded linear maps and continuous products; in particular P0(f^2) is continuous on L2 and the fourth H_tau term has two H^1 factors. For fixed tau>0 all coefficients are finite. Each nonlinear increment has zero mean and preserves reality. Starting from convergence of the initial values, continuity gives convergence of every fixed finite iterate by induction. S003 uses norm continuity at each of the L+1 grid points, retaining the same C0,tau0 without any interchange of a timestep limit or an infinite maximum. Set C=C0; n=0 and the u0 instance are included.
